Definition: the heart (as the most interior organ);
BiblicalUsage: 1) inner man, mind, will, heart, soul, understanding; 1a) inner part, midst; 1a1) midst (of things); 1a2) heart (of man); 1a3) soul, heart (of man); 1a4) mind, knowledge, thinking, reflection, memory; 1a5) inclination, resolution, determination (of will); 1a6) conscience; 1a7) heart (of moral character); 1a8) as seat of appetites; 1a9) as seat of emotions and passions 1a10) as seat of courage
